Founding Partner

CA Pavan S. Toshniwal

M.Com., FCA

PROFESSIONAL PROFILE

CA Pavan S. Toshniwal is a Fellow member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (FCA) and a founding partner of P S B & Associates LLP. With over a decade of practice across direct taxation, cross-border structuring, and transfer pricing, he advises corporate groups, high-growth enterprises, and international clients on fiscal compliance and strategic tax risk management.

Practice focus: Corporate Income Tax · International Taxation · Transfer Pricing · Project Financing

Pavan actively leads the firm’s project financing, private equity syndication, and financial restructuring mandates, assisting promoters in structuring capital and securing institutional funding under regulatory guidelines.
